text.name: Ring of Oblivion
text.description:
{Ring of Oblivion}

Worn on a finger, this item makes all losses in the battle irrevocable:  lost creatures in a unit cannot be restored by any means, and corpses disappear right after the unit's death.
text.event: You stand on a field, where a large battle was fought not so long ago. You are troubled by the complete absence of corpses. Amongst the broken swords and armors you discover a ring.
